capabilities: Log time blocks by dragging across a 10-minute grid timeline and edit them by clicking
Add, check, and delete to-dos in a docked sidebar panel
Export any day as a standalone printable HTML or PDF file
Summarize vault-wide streaks, completion rates, and category time breakdowns in Work Insights
Configure daily note folder and moment.js filename format, importable from core Daily Notes
disambiguation: Not a plain work journal; it renders a draggable time-grid sidebar, to-do panel, and statistics on top of ordinary daily note text.
extras: Not yet published in the Community Plugins browser, so it must be installed manually from release files. The DayTime Tracker migration script exists only in the source repository, and the README warns to run a dry run and back up the vault before writing. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Switching from DayTime Tracker? That plugin stores its data as timeline-logs / timeline-todos YAML frontmatter properties
problem: Daily notes don't visualize time blocks or to-dos, and tracking tools typically require YAML frontmatter metadata instead of plain note text.
